text:
Nora Fields: Quick sync  release post + benchmark appendix + webinar tomorrow. Target publish 09:40am PT but we'll gate on Dedicated canary. Need final changelog URL and docs landing ready.

Ethan Park: Will merge release PR by 08:20am PT. Changelog URL should be https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.12 once it's live. Ops, can you share the canary window?

bench-bot: Benchmark check: draft numbers approved by ML team. Suggested blog phrasing: "p95 latency down 14% with production batching; token cost down ~19% on typical chat workloads."

Mina Shah: Please note the quickstart auth header still had the old header example. I'll prep a cherrypick and aim to merge by 08:10am PT so CDN can rebuild by ~09:00am PT.

Kai Roberts: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-25T08:55:00Z -> 10% 08:55Z, 50% 09:10Z, 100% 09:25Z. Pause criteria: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 3m or latency spike above SLA. Marketing hold if paused.

Sam R: Draft social copy: "Redwood Optimize v0.12: smarter batching + routing. p95 down 14%, token cost down ~19%. Live webinar 10am PT. Blog + benchmarks -> link in bio." Thoughts?

Nora Fields: Love it. We'll schedule CMS at 09:20am PT for 09:40am PT publish (gives 15m observation after full rollout). Sam, prep webinar reminder 10m/1m. Mina, please drop the docs link here when live so we can swap placeholders.

Ethan Park: Release PR merged at 08:18am PT. Changelog generation in process.

Mina Shah: Cherrypick merged; docs build kicked. Docs landing: https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v0.12. Changelog should be live shortly.

bench-bot: ML requested exact wording change to blog copy: "p95 latency improved 14% under production batching; token cost reduced ~19% for our common chat mix." Use that verbatim.

Kai Roberts: Canary stage1 (10%) healthy. Stage2 starting at 09:10Z.

Ethan Park: Changelog now live: https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.12. Marking PR merged and tags applied.

Mina Shah: Links live and CDN warmed. Replaced CMS placeholders.

Sam R: Swapped links in CMS and queued publish for 09:20am PT to go live at 09:40am PT. Social threads ready, webinar reminders queued.

Kai Roberts: Canary reached 100% at 09:25Z. No critical alerts during rollout. Monitoring green.

Nora Fields: Publishing now. We'll monitor engagement + errors for first 30m. If anything pops, tag eng-oncall and pause socials. :rocket:

Sam R: Published and pushed social. Webinar reminder sent 10m out.

Nora Fields: Closing thread  will post a short post-launch note with top metrics and any action items after the webinar. :white_check_mark:
